Please let me know if you need any other information as we move forward with contract negotiations. We are committed to working within your budget while providing high quality materials.

Thank you for considering Acme Steel Co. for your downtown construction project's steel supply requirements. 

To address your request for a competitive volume quote:

For the 1,000 ton quantity specified, we can offer a discounted unit price of $585 per ton. This yields a total price of $585,000 for the full order.

We are able to provide up to a 12% discount on this premium steel grade to accommodate higher volume orders such as yours. The quoted pricing already reflects a 10% volume discount from our standard rates.

In terms of payment terms, we typically require 50% upfront with the remaining 50% net 30 days after delivery. However, we can be flexible and extend net 60 day terms for this project if needed.

Delivery will be direct from our mills with an estimated 4-6 week lead time to the construction site. All steel will come with mill certifications and testing documentation.

Please let me know if you need any other details or have additional requirements. I'm happy to discuss further adjustments within the bounds of our costs and target margins.
